fusion_rules.rule: Intercept destructive Git commands before execution and provide a configurable, verifiable local guardrail.
Accept only: A command hook environment, dangerous-command policy, and local configuration.
Produce only: An installed and tested command guard; normal release packaging remains out of scope.
Preserve explicit source variants and gaps; never upgrade a missing dimension or source preference into a universal rule.

input_boundary: A command hook environment, dangerous-command policy, and local configuration.
output_boundary: An installed and tested command guard; normal release packaging remains out of scope.

source_dimension_matrix.approach: 通过配置 PreToolUse 钩子在智能体执行命令前拦截高危 Git 操作的物理防护机制。; 通过模拟发送 git push 载荷验证钩子脚本返回退出码 2 并在 stderr 打印 BLOCKED 信息的验证门禁。; 遍历扫描危险模式，若匹配则向 stderr 输出阻断提示并以退出码 2 终止，若全部通过则以退出码 0 放行。
source_dimension_matrix.limitations: Explicit limits: 适用于宿主支持 PreToolUse 拦截事件的 AI CLI 环境。; 必须在实际投入使用前通过管道命令完成干跑验证。; 依赖 grep -qE 进行模式匹配，以退出码 2 表示拦截，0 表示放行。
source_dimension_matrix.strengths: Provides 9 source-grounded atom(s) for responsibility (gate=1, method=5, rule=2, template=1); each is bound to an exact source citation.
